response.sql: WITH store_counts AS (SELECT s.store_id, COUNT(c.customer_id) AS customer_count FROM store AS s LEFT JOIN customer AS c ON c.store_id = s.store_id GROUP BY s.store_id) SELECT sc.store_id, sc.customer_count, sc.customer_count / t.total_customers AS customer_share, sc.customer_count * t.store_count / t.total_customers AS multiple_of_average FROM store_counts AS sc CROSS JOIN (SELECT SUM(customer_count) AS total_customers, COUNT(*) AS store_count FROM store_counts) AS t ORDER BY sc.store_id;
